about: The real plane (Crewluve moving map Stage 3 spec §4 to §7, §10.2). Made by a reference written apart from the app and the website, and run by both: the app's FlightPlanTests, FlightPathTests, FlightRecordTests, LiveProgressTests, LiveLabelTests and LiveWindowTests, and the website's tests. Change both copies together. Every `at`, and every time in an answer, is an ISO 8601 time with milliseconds. A `flight` is one entry of partner_live's `flights`, exactly as the door answers it, with times in milliseconds since 1970, or null where the door answers none. Distances are nautical miles of 1,852 m along a sphere of radius 6,371,008.8 m, to the nearest thousandth; places are [latitude, longitude]. A gap is the plan's touchdown minus the estimated one in minutes, rounded to the nearest with halves away from zero; ahead is positive. A path's `ownSpeedKt` is the plane's own speed over its cruise so far, or null when too little of it has been seen, and a flight's `flownSpeedKt` is the speed its estimate, its estimated plane and its ghost fly the cruise at. When its own speed is from 0.7 of the plan's to 1.5 of it, the cruise left from the last place it was seen is flown at its own speed for `ownSpeedAheadMinutes`, or all the way when that's further, and at the plan's after that, and `flownSpeedKt` is the one speed that flies it all in the same time. Otherwise it's the plan's. A plane on the ground within 10 nm of its departure airport has returned when its whole trail has climbed `returnClimbFeet` or more, its highest point over its lowest, and its label is "Returned". A path, its record and its own speed are made from the trail's latest try, which starts again at a place seen in the air within `firstPointRadiusNm` of the departure airport more than `restartGapMinutes` after the point before it, which was within `airportRadiusNm`, once the try before had climbed `returnClimbFeet`; the fix in the air, when it's newer than the trail, can start one with no trail points yet; while the plane is back there, from no points. Compare speeds to 0.01 kt. Compare distances to 0.01 nm, times to 0.05 s and places to 0.0001 of a degree.

plans.name: a long leg
plans.note: Louisville to Cologne in 8 h: 15 min out and 7 in leave 7 h 38 min in the air. The last 120 nm take 25.7 min at 280 kt, and the rest is one faster speed.

plans.name: a leg of an hour and three quarters
plans.note: Louisville to Philadelphia: the descent rule still applies, with a cruise a little over 400 kt.

plans.name: a short leg
plans.note: Louisville to Cincinnati is under 120 nm, so it has one steady speed from takeoff to touchdown.

plans.name: a leg under both allowances
plans.note: A 30-minute block is too short for the taxi allowances, so the plane flies from gate to gate at one speed.

plans.name: a block of exactly 32 minutes
plans.note: Just long enough for both allowances and the shortest cruise: 15 min out, 7 in, and 10 in the air.

plans.name: a slow leg
plans.note: Louisville to Philadelphia in 3 h: the cruise would be under 280 kt, so the whole leg is one steady speed.

plans.name: a leg that goes nowhere
plans.note: The same airport at both ends has no speed of its own, so 280 kt stands in.

flights.name: ahead, in the air
flights.note: Off the ground about ten minutes before the plan, by way of a point north of the straight line, with a trail point every 2 minutes and a fix 40 s after the last. The first point is under 30 nm out, so its time is the takeoff and the leg starts early. It has been seen for 18 minutes of its cruise, 120 nm or more from both airports, so its own speed, 430 kt, stands in for the plan's: the landing estimate is the fix plus the time for the straight distance left at that speed, with the last 120 nm at 280 kt. The ghost flies the same, so the gap between the planes is still the label.

moments.note: The fix is 10 s old: in the air, at the fix. The ghost is behind the real plane.
moments.label: 14 min ahead

moments.note: The fix is exactly 3 minutes old: still in the air.
moments.label: 14 min ahead

moments.note: A second more: estimated.
moments.label: About 14 min ahead

moments.note: The fix is over 3 minutes old: estimated, flying on from the fix at its own speed. The estimate holds still.
moments.label: About 14 min ahead

moments.note: Past the estimated touchdown with no landing seen: the estimated plane is at Philadelphia, and the leg has ended at the live arrival.
moments.label: About 14 min ahead

flights.name: off early and the long way round
flights.note: In the air 13 minutes before the plan's takeoff, heading west before turning back, so its path is longer than the straight distance. Until the plan's takeoff the ghost waits at Louisville. Just after it, the ghost is already as far along the path as the path is longer than the plan.

moments.note: A minute before the plan's takeoff: the ghost is still at the airport.
moments.label: On schedule

moments.note: Twenty seconds after it: the ghost has jumped along the path.
moments.label: On schedule

flights.name: off late, and seen from the start
flights.note: Its first point is 3 nm out at 12:25, ten minutes after the plan's takeoff. The takeoff is known and late, and a late departure doesn't move the leg: its start stays at 12:00. Only its newest place is 120 nm from Louisville or more, so its own speed isn't known yet and the plan's stands.

moments.note: In the air, with the start where the schedule has it.
moments.label: 8 min behind

flights.name: a short hop, off two minutes early
flights.note: A 30-minute block has no taxi allowances and one steady speed. So the leg starts at the takeoff itself, and the live arrival is the touchdown.

moments.note: In the air: the start is the takeoff, and the end is the touchdown.
moments.label: 6 min ahead

flights.name: in the air, with no trail point yet
flights.note: A fix in the air and an empty trail. The path is real from the fix: Louisville to the fix, then the great circle on. The fix is under 30 nm out, so its time is the takeoff.

moments.note: In the air, at the fix.
moments.label: On schedule

flights.name: the fix is the last trail point
flights.note: Right after a trail point is written, the fix has its place and its time. It adds nothing to the path: one stretch fewer than the ahead flight, whose fix is 40 s newer.

moments.note: In the air, at the last trail point.
moments.label: 14 min ahead

flights.name: points out of order, ten minutes apart, and two at once
flights.note: The trail comes as 12:05, 12:25, 12:15, 12:35 and a second point stamped 12:25 a little further on. It's put in order of time, with the two of one time in the order they came. Points exactly 10 minutes apart are seen: only more than 10 is unseen. At 12:25 the plane is at the second of the two.

moments.note: In the air.
moments.label: 14 min ahead

flights.name: behind, with a late first point and an unseen ocean
flights.note: Off 25 minutes after the plan and slower than it. The first point is 96 nm out, so the join from Louisville is unseen and the takeoff isn't known: the leg's start stays. Nobody saw it for nearly 3 hours over the ocean: one unseen join. Its own speed is measured across that join too, from the first place 120 nm or more from Louisville to the last, and it's slower than the plan's, so it lands later still. The ghost is ahead of the real plane, and the leg ends late.

moments.note: In the air and behind: the ghost is further along the path than the real plane.
moments.label: 55 min behind

moments.note: Estimated: "About" joins the label.
moments.label: About 55 min behind

flights.name: ten minutes of its cruise seen
flights.note: Its first place 120 nm or more from Louisville was seen at 12:22:00 and its newest at 12:32:00: ten minutes of its cruise, which is enough. Its own speed stands in for the plan's.

moments.note: In the air, by its own speed.
moments.label: 14 min ahead

flights.name: a second under ten minutes of its cruise seen
flights.note: The same, with the first place 120 nm or more from Louisville seen a second later. That isn't enough yet: the plan's speed stands, and the estimate is later than its own speed would have it.

moments.note: In the air, by the plan's speed.
moments.label: 12 min ahead

flights.name: in its descent, with the ghost still in the cruise
flights.note: It flew 430 kt for 384 nm and has slowed to 240 kt, under 120 nm from Philadelphia. Its own speed was measured to the last place it was seen 120 nm or more from Philadelphia, and the slower places since don't change it. The estimate needs only the descent's 280 kt now. The ghost, 32 minutes from the plan's touchdown, is still in the cruise, at the plane's own speed.

moments.note: In the air, in its descent.
moments.label: 13 min ahead

flights.name: out and back before it leaves
flights.note: It flew 60 nm west and back over Louisville before setting off, so it has 265 nm behind it along its path and is only 145 nm from Louisville. Its cruise is counted from 120 nm from the airport in a straight line, not along the path: it has been seen for under three minutes of that, so its own speed isn't known yet and the plan's stands.

moments.note: In the air, by the plan's speed.
moments.label: On schedule

flights.name: a return, a wait and a second start
flights.note: It flew out to 150 nm, came back to 60 nm from Louisville, wasn't seen for twenty minutes there, and set off again. Its own speed counts only the stretches between two places seen in its cruise: six minutes of the first start and all of the second, and none of the way back inside 120 nm or the wait. It comes to 419 kt, a little under the 430 kt it flew, because it turned back between two places seen two minutes apart, which are closer together than the way it flew between them.

moments.note: In the air, and very late.
moments.label: 31 min behind

flights.name: a hold inside the last 120 nm
flights.note: It slowed to 240 kt 135 nm short of Philadelphia, and then flew out to the north and back, inside 120 nm of the airport, which made its path longer. The places seen in the hold are all under 120 nm from Philadelphia, so they never count towards its own speed, however long the path grows.

moments.note: In the air, holding.
moments.label: On schedule

flights.name: much faster than the plan, and believed
flights.note: At 557 kt, 1.4 times the plan's cruise speed: a strong wind behind it. That's believed.

moments.note: In the air, by its own speed.
moments.label: 26 min ahead

flights.name: too fast to be right
flights.note: Places that put it at 640 kt, 1.6 times the plan's cruise speed. Over 1.5 times isn't believed: something is wrong with the places, and the plan's speed stands.

moments.note: In the air, by the plan's speed.
moments.label: 25 min ahead

flights.name: much slower than the plan, and believed
flights.note: At 300 kt, three quarters of the plan's cruise speed: a strong wind against it. That's believed.

moments.note: In the air, by its own speed.
moments.label: 9 min behind

flights.name: too slow to be right
flights.note: Places that put it at 255 kt, 0.64 of the plan's cruise speed. Under 0.7 isn't believed either, and the plan's speed stands.

moments.note: In the air, by the plan's speed.
moments.label: 8 min behind

flights.name: a slow leg keeps its one speed
flights.note: A 300 kt flight on a block of 2 h 15 min, whose plan is one steady speed of 265 kt with no descent of its own. Its own speed is known, and near the plan's, and still isn't used: a leg with one steady speed keeps it.

moments.note: In the air, by the plan's one speed.
moments.label: 15 min ahead

flights.name: on the ground before the plan's takeoff
flights.note: Seen on the ground half a mile from Louisville's airport. Before 12:15 there's no estimate and no label, and the schedule stands. A ground fix over 3 minutes old isn't live.

moments.note: On the ground, before the plan's takeoff: the ghost waits at the airport too.
The ground fix is exactly 3 minutes old: still on the ground.
A second more: not live.
The ground fix is 3.5 minutes old: not live.

flights.name: still on the ground just after the plan's takeoff
flights.note: Three minutes after the plan's takeoff, touchdown is now plus the plan's 83 minutes in the air, and the label has no number yet.

moments.note: Three minutes late: within 5, so just "Still on the ground".
moments.label: Still on the ground

flights.name: still on the ground twenty minutes after
flights.note: Twenty minutes after the plan's takeoff the label counts from it, and the leg's end has slid 20 minutes later.

moments.note: Twenty minutes late.
moments.label: Still on the ground · 20 min behind

flights.name: an air return, back on the ground
flights.note: Off at 12:04:34, out 40 nm and straight back, climbing to 8,500 ft and down again, and on the ground at Louisville at 12:40. Its trail climbed 1,000 ft or more, so it has returned: the label is "Returned", the real plane is at its fix with no ghost, and touchdown is now plus the plan's 83 minutes in the air, as for a plane still on the ground. The way out and back isn't its path: the path is the great circle, and there's no record.

moments.note: Back at the airport, 26 minutes after the plan's takeoff.
moments.label: Returned

moments.note: The ground fix is just over 3 minutes old: not live.

flights.name: an air return, then off again
flights.note: The same air return, then off again at 13:20. Its first point after the wait is 18 nm from Louisville, within 30 nm, an hour after the last point of the return, which was 3 nm out: the trail starts again there. Its path, record, own speed, landing estimate and ghost are made from the second try alone.

moments.note: In the air again, and very late.
moments.label: 1 h 4 min behind

flights.name: an air return, then off again and seen only at its fix
flights.note: The same air return, then off again at 13:20 and seen in the air at 13:21:30, 11 nm out, before its first new trail point. The fix starts the trail again by itself: the path is the fix's alone, with nothing of the way out and back.

moments.note: In the air again, an hour late.
moments.label: 1 h 5 min behind

flights.name: a stray point while taxiing
flights.note: One point in the air at 500 ft while the plane taxied, and on the ground ever since. One point can't climb, so it hasn't returned: it's still on the ground.

moments.note: Five and a half minutes after the plan's takeoff: still on the ground, 6 minutes behind.
moments.label: Still on the ground · 6 min behind

flights.name: landed, seen all the way
flights.note: The same flight, followed to Philadelphia and seen on the ground there. Its path ends at the airport with nothing planned, the landing is when it was first seen down, and the leg ends 7 minutes after that.

moments.note: Landed: early, with no "about".
moments.label: Landed 23 min early

flights.name: landed, with the approach unseen
flights.note: Seen to 12:41, then not again until it was on the ground at Philadelphia: the last join is unseen.

moments.note: Landed.
moments.label: Landed 23 min early

flights.name: landed, with a landing time before its last point
flights.note: Crewlu Cloud never sends this, and a record can't run backwards: the landing counts as no earlier than the last point, 12:41, for the record and the estimate alike.

moments.note: Landed at 12:41, not 12:40.
moments.label: Landed 57 min early

flights.name: landed, and never seen in the air
flights.note: Landed with an empty trail: there's no real path and no record, the real plane is at Philadelphia, and the leg ends 7 minutes after the landing.

moments.note: Landed, on the great circle.
moments.label: Landed 18 min early

flights.name: on the ground somewhere else
flights.note: Seen on the ground at Pittsburgh, which is neither airport: a diversion. The real plane shows where it is, with no estimate, label or ghost.

moments.note: Elsewhere.

flights.name: waiting to be seen
flights.note: CrewLu Cloud is watching, and nobody has seen it: the schedule's plane alone.

moments.note: Not live.

flights.name: no live data
flights.note: The answer has no flight for the leg.

moments.note: Not live.

flights.name: faster than the plan, then a long ocean gap
flights.note: Off on time along the great circle at 560 kt, faster than the plan's 508.1 kt, seen every 4 minutes until 19:39 and at the fix at 19:39:30, and never again. 2,872 nm of its cruise is left from the fix: the first 1,120 nm, 2 hours of it, are flown at its own 560 kt and the rest at the plan's, which is one speed of 527.1 kt over all of it and a touchdown at 01:32, 21 minutes ahead. At its own speed all the way it would be 01:13. The landing estimate, the estimated plane and the ghost all fly the one speed, and the estimate holds still through the gap.

moments.note: In the air, at the fix.
moments.label: 21 min ahead

moments.note: The fix is just over 3 minutes old: estimated, with the same estimate.
moments.label: About 21 min ahead

moments.note: Two hours on from the fix, far out over the ocean.
moments.label: About 21 min ahead

moments.note: Nearly there, still unseen: the estimate is the same as at the fix.
moments.label: About 21 min ahead

Still on the ground · 20 min behind
Still on the ground · 1 h 35 min behind

3 hours after, in the air with a fix 10 minutes old
3 hours after, in the air with a fix 31 minutes old
3 hours after, in the air with a fix exactly 30 minutes old
3 hours after, on the ground with a new fix
